nodes.description: ERC20 token contract being held by the timelock (IERC20 private _token)
Address that receives the held tokens after release (address private _beneficiary)
Timestamp after which tokens may be released (uint256 private _releaseTime)
TokenTimelock constructor: validates releaseTime > block.timestamp and stores token, beneficiary and releaseTime
Public view returning the held token contract (_token)
Public view returning the beneficiary address (_beneficiary)
Public view returning the release timestamp (_releaseTime)
Virtual function that checks block.timestamp >= _releaseTime and transfers the full held balance to the beneficiary
CATXTimeLock constructor that forwards token, beneficiary and releaseTime to the TokenTimelock base constructor
Miner-influenced block timestamp used in the constructor validation and in the release time gate
External ERC20 transfer of the whole contract balance to _beneficiary performed inside release(); beneficiary may be a contract able to re-enter
Timestamp dependency: require(block.timestamp >= _releaseTime) controls when the release payout can be executed
IERC20 token constructor parameter of TokenTimelock
address beneficiary constructor parameter of TokenTimelock
uint256 releaseTime constructor parameter of TokenTimelock
Local uint256 amount in release(), set to _token.balanceOf(address(this)) and transferred to the beneficiary
address token constructor parameter of CATXTimeLock, cast to IERC20 for the base constructor
address beneficiary constructor parameter of CATXTimeLock
uint256 releaseTime constructor parameter of CATXTimeLock
Library function that encodes token.transfer(to, value) and performs a low-level optional-return external call

edges.reason: constructor token parameter is written into state variable _token
constructor beneficiary parameter is written into state variable _beneficiary
constructor releaseTime parameter is written into state variable _releaseTime
constructor enforces require(releaseTime > block.timestamp), so behaviour depends on the miner-controllable timestamp
block.timestamp feeds the release-time gate that authorises the payout
_releaseTime is compared against block.timestamp in the release gate
the timestamp comparison gates whether release() may proceed to the transfer
release() reads _releaseTime to decide if the timelock has expired
release() reads the _token state variable to query the balance and perform the transfer
_token.balanceOf(address(this)) produces the local amount value
token() returns the _token state variable
beneficiary() returns the _beneficiary state variable
releaseTime() returns the _releaseTime state variable
release() computes the local amount before transferring it
the local amount is the value passed to the external transfer of the full balance
_beneficiary is the recipient of the external transfer and may be an attacker-controlled contract
release() hands control to the external token contract while transferring funds to the beneficiary, enabling reentrancy
release() delegates the token payout to SafeERC20.safeTransfer, the external interaction point
safeTransfer performs the low-level external ERC20 call that constitutes the unsafe operation
CATXTimeLock constructor invokes the TokenTimelock base constructor
token parameter of CATXTimeLock flows into its constructor body
beneficiary parameter of CATXTimeLock flows into its constructor body
releaseTime parameter of CATXTimeLock flows into its constructor body

normalization_plan.reason: constructor parameter token is only used to initialise the _token state variable inside TokenTimelock.constructor
constructor parameter beneficiary is only used to initialise the _beneficiary state variable inside TokenTimelock.constructor
constructor parameter releaseTime is only used to initialise the _releaseTime state variable and the timestamp check inside TokenTimelock.constructor
local variable amount exists only inside TokenTimelock.release and is immediately consumed by the external transfer
CATXTimeLock token parameter is only used to forward the token into the base constructor
CATXTimeLock beneficiary parameter is only used to forward the beneficiary into the base constructor
CATXTimeLock releaseTime parameter is only used to forward the release time into the base constructor
